mail.confirm.subject.note: Subject of the mail after a registration. {host} is the host name of the site, for example it-skills.net. One line.

mail.confirm.body.text:
Hello {handle},

please confirm your e-mail address with this link:

{link}

The page then asks for the password that you chose when you registered.
{validity} You can sign in only after that.
If you did not register, ignore this e-mail. Then nothing is stored.
mail.confirm.body.note: Text of the mail after a registration, plain text with line breaks. {handle} is the name of the new account, {link} the link to the account page that confirms it, {validity} the sentence of mail.confirm.validity.

text.one: The link is valid for {count} hour.
text.other: The link is valid for {count} hours.

mail.confirm.validity.note: Sentence in the mail after a registration (mail.confirm.body). {count} is the number of hours, 48.

mail.registered.subject.note: Subject of the mail to an address that has an account already, when somebody registers with it again. {host} is the host name of the site. One line.

mail.registered.body.text:
Hello,

somebody wanted to make a new account with this e-mail address. You already have an account.

Sign in here: {link}
Forgot your password? You can set a new one there.

If this was not you, ignore this e-mail. Your account stays as it is.
mail.registered.body.note: Text of the mail to an address that has an account already, plain text with line breaks. {link} is the address of the account page.

mail.invitation.subject.note: Subject of an invitation mail. {team} is the name of the team, {host} the host name of the site. One line.

mail.invitation.body.text:
Hello,

{inviter} invites you to the team “{team}” ({handle}), with the role {role}.

With this link you see the invitation and accept it:

{link}

You need an account for it. You can sign in with any account or make a new one.
{validity}
If you do not want the invitation, ignore this e-mail.
mail.invitation.body.note: Text of an invitation mail, plain text with line breaks. {inviter} is the name of the account that invites, {team} the name of the team, {handle} its name in the address, {role} the role (mail.role.owner, .editor or .reader), {link} the link to the invitation on the account page, {validity} the sentence of mail.invitation.validity.

text.one: The link is valid for {count} day and works only once.
text.other: The link is valid for {count} days and works only once.

mail.invitation.validity.note: Sentence in an invitation mail (mail.invitation.body). {count} is the number of days, 7.

mail.role.owner.note: The team role owner in an invitation mail, after “with the role”.

mail.role.editor.note: The team role editor in an invitation mail, after “with the role”.

mail.role.reader.note: The team role reader in an invitation mail, after “with the role”.

mail.reset.subject.note: Subject of the mail with the link for a new password. {host} is the host name of the site. One line.

mail.reset.body.text:
Hello {handle},

with this link you set a new password:

{link}

The link is valid for one hour and works only once.
If you did not ask for a new password, ignore this e-mail. Your password stays as it is.
mail.reset.body.note: Text of the mail with the link for a new password, plain text with line breaks. {handle} is the name of the account, {link} the link to the account page that sets the password. The link is valid for 60 minutes.
